title: Page 4
lines: 蓬莱难过地低下头看着睡得香甜的再莱，心中也明白大师兄不想让她习武的原因。这样的她，一旦练就了武艺，万一日后心术不正或是被人利用了怎么办？水可载舟亦可覆舟，或许她的武艺在日后能够让她自保，可她亦可能会成为武林中的猛兽……
是佛是魔，都只在一念之间而已。
将她捡来的师父大人黄金，也知道这孩子被家人丢弃的原因正是因为她的呆笨，只是他却没有大徒弟考虑的那么多。
他沉重地叹了口气，“算了，为师也不强求小六日后必定要有出息或有什么大成就，反正我黄金门又不是养不起她，这孩子，咱们好生养着就是了……”
于是自那日起，名唤为再莱的女娃就正式在黄金门住下了，大师兄偶尔会点拨一下她的武艺，却从没正式教导过她，而全师门上下对她这天生的乖宝宝则是能宠着就尽量宠着，也从没要求她太多……
还被人拎着在手上的月穹，好奇的语调打断了蓬莱满脑子的回忆，瞬间就将他给拉回现实。
“二师兄，你方才给小六的是什么？”
蓬莱松开手，“路国皇帝要找个相级的保镖。”
“保镖任务？”月穹脸上不正经的调调当下不见了，她转过身一脸严肃地问：“这差事你不会是打算给小六吧？”他想将他们家的软妹子踢出去见见世面？
月穹随即推翻了他的决定，“我代她去。”
“这已经是最简单的差事了，就只是当个保镖而已，她只要出出力就行。”蓬莱没好气地解释，早就料到她会是这个反应。
“你肯定小六不会砸锅？”就算再莱的武艺妖孽到能在少许的指导下晋入相级好了，一直都被养在师门内的她，哪曾见过师门外头的风雨？二师兄他又不是不知再莱不能和常人相提并论。
蓬莱皱着眉，“我会要她背牢师门任务守则的……”
“还是我替她去吧，不然她要是被人卖了，我怕她还会开心的帮人数钱。”打小就被他们宠着护着的六师妹哪能出门去让人欺负？二师兄也不怕全师门的师弟妹们都赶回来砍他。
“小六长大了，你们不能总惯着她，且她只是反应慢了点，又不是真的笨。”蓬莱揉揉隐隐作疼的两际，硬是狠下了心，“总之，这事我会去同大师兄商议，相信大师兄他也定会赞成我这么做。”
月穹冷冷哼了口气，“反正到时要是出了岔子，回头要出门替小六收拾后果的，还不是老妈子你？”
“你还好意思说？”蓬莱用力瞪她一眼，“打小到大，哪一回你们捅了楼子收拾后果的不是我？”
“随便你。”她说着说着拐个弯就想往外头走，“没我的事了吧？我去找小六聊聊。”
“甭急着躲，大师兄还等着见你呢。”蓬莱哪能让她跑了？在她脚底抹油前就将她给转过身子，扬指轻轻在她眉心一点。
当下无法动弹的月穹僵着脸，“二、二师兄……”
“现在知道要叫师兄了？平时都干嘛去了？”蓬莱公事公办地弯下身将她扛至肩上，接着迈开大步往后山佛堂的方向走去。
“等等……咱们有话好好说，没必要动不动就去佛堂嘛……”终于体悟到这回难逃一劫的月穹，被吓得不只是一颗心颤了又颤，就连声音都抖得有点飘。
“光天化日之下，明目张胆的在大街上掳男人是吧？剥光男人画裸画是吧？为祸西苑国让西苑皇帝派人来同我告状是吧？我黄金门的脸又被你丢光了是吧？还害我被大师兄训斥教导师妹不力是吧？”蓬莱毫不怜香惜玉地抬起一掌，每问一句，掌心就重重落在她欠揍的屁股上一下。
“二师兄，我发誓往后绝不再写小黄书了！”一把年纪还遭人这么打，这让月穹的脸红得跟猴屁股似的。
“你发誓像放屁。”稳健的步伐继续朝后山迈进。
“我保证再也不画裸男了！”
“既然剥过男人的衣裳，那么下回你就会去脱女人衣裳了，你以为我会纵容你再出门去染指其他男男女女？”完全不相信她的蓬莱，决定要彻底防堵任何可能性。
“那……那咱们打个商量，这回别罚我陪着大师兄念经抄经行不？”眼看后山愈来愈近，月穹不由得急出一身冷汗来。
“意思就是你更想被大师兄打个半死？放心，师兄我这么友爱师妹你，我定会成全你这微不足道的心愿。”
回想起大师兄以往种种暴虐不仁、令人发指的教育手段，月穹只沉默了一会儿便急忙大叫。
“二师兄我错了！”
“晚了。”
可以把这尊半仙塞回天上去吗？
他真是悔不当初啊……
每日被顾醒折腾得奄奄一息的路翔无一日不这么想。
据这名被他封为仙师的魂役所言，他许愿所许出来的这名大牌魂役，来自天界，乃是已得道的半仙，顾醒之所以是半仙而不是神仙，是因仙龄未至便已未亡，故而死得不甘心的顾醒，这才会被许愿许出来成了凡人的魂役。
对于成了凡人的魂役这一点，顾醒非但没有半点认分还有着一肚子的不满，更拒绝为身为魂主的路翔效劳。
身为半仙的他，压根就没把那张魂纸的血契给看在眼里，更不接受凡人的指使，他还扬言，他们若敢对他这半仙不敬或是想强迫他做任何事，他就动手杀了魂主，在与魂主同归于尽后……拍拍屁股轮回去。
反正都巳死过一回了，再死一次，对他来说也没什么差别。
路翔和路露听得齐齐傻眼。
同……同归于尽？
将顾醒视为最后一根浮木的他们，费心尽力许愿将他给许出来，可不是为了要与他携手共赴黄泉啊！
无奈仙势比人强，谁教半仙也是仙？只要顾醒一日不肯点头，他们这些个被他视为无物的凡人，就一日拿他半点法子也没有。
尤其是在他们知道，这位半仙在天上时曾是只得道仙龟后。
怪不得他的动作老是那么慢，一里的路程他可以走上两年，性子还龟毛无比！
被顾醒天生的龟性整得日日无言以对的路翔，近来的日子，是一日过得比一日想抓狂。
好声好气的与顾醒说话，他冷眉以对。
加上他慢，什么都慢，动作慢也就算了，他连说话也可以慢得让听的人听得快断气！常常听他说了上一句话，捺住了性子想等到他的下一句，等着等着，通常就是一个时辰后了，而要想听他完整的把一大段话给说完，就算是等得日以继夜、海枯石烂，只要顾醒心情不好，他就永远也等不完……
还有，好吃好喝地把顾醒供着，大爷他也不买账。
顾醒每日就是慢条斯理的拈着兰花的花瓣，一瓣一瓣的、慢吞吞的往嘴里送，细嚼慢咽地品味着花瓣的滋味，却看也不看路翔特意为他准备的那些山珍海味一眼。
在相处了好阵子后，吃过无数苦头的路翔，总算是摸清了点这尊仙师的规矩。
这名天上来的仙龟大人，只喝清晨叶梢上的露水，只吃兰花的花瓣，且兰花的品种还有严格的限定，若非这种兰花其他一概不食，还有花朵不新鲜他不吃，花开得不够美、香味不够浓他老兄拒吃，时辰不对他也照样不吃！
不得已之下，路翔只好将御花园里所种植的各种珍稀奇兰都给铲了，改而全面种起由仙师大人指定，那种路国到处都可看得到，还不值一文钱的路边杂草兰，省得那只挑嘴的仙龟经常就板着一张棺材脸给他看。
content_en:
Penglai lowered his head sadly and looked at Zai Lai, who was sleeping soundly. He also understood in his heart the reason why his senior brother did not want her to practice martial arts. Once she has mastered martial arts, what if she has evil intentions or is taken advantage of in the future? Water can carry or capsize a boat. Perhaps her martial arts skills will allow her to protect herself in the future, but she may also become a ferocious beast in the martial arts world...
Whether he is a Buddha or a demon, it is just a thought.
Master Jin Huang, who picked her up, also knew that the reason why this child was abandoned by her family was precisely because of her stupidity, but he did not consider it as much as his eldest disciple thought.
He sighed heavily, "Forget it, as a teacher, I don't insist that Xiaoliu must be successful or have any great achievements in the future. Anyway, it's not like our Golden Gate can't afford to support her. Let's just have a good time and raise this child..."
So from that day on, the girl named Zai Lai officially lived in the Golden Gate. The senior brother would occasionally give her some advice on martial arts, but he never taught her formally. The whole family pampered her as a naturally good baby as much as they could, and never asked her too much...
Yue Qiong, who was still being held in someone's hand, interrupted Penglai's mind full of memories with his curious tone, instantly bringing him back to reality.
"Second Senior Brother, what did you just give Xiao Liu?"
Penglai let go of his hand and said, "The Emperor of Lu State wants to find a bodyguard of prime minister level."
"Bodyguard mission?" The unserious tone on Yue Qiong's face disappeared immediately. She turned around and asked with a serious face: "You don't plan to give this job to Xiao Liu, do you?" He wants to kick their weak girl out to see the world?
"Yeah."
Yue Qiong immediately overturned his decision, "I will go on her behalf."
"This is already the simplest job. She is just a bodyguard. All she has to do is contribute." Penglai explained angrily, having already expected this reaction from her.
"Are you sure Xiao Liu won't smash the pot?" Even if the martial arts monster is good enough to be promoted to the prime minister level with a little guidance, she has been raised in the teacher's sect, how has she ever seen the wind and rain outside the teacher's sect? Second Senior Brother, it's not like he can't compare with ordinary people no matter how good he is.
Penglai frowned, "I will ask her to memorize the rules of the prisoner sect..."
"I'd better go for her, otherwise if she is sold, I'm afraid she will happily help count the money." How could Junior Sister Six, who had been pampered and protected by them since she was a child, go out and let others bully her? The second senior brother is not afraid that all the junior brothers and sisters in the division will come back and chop him down.
"Xiao Liu has grown up, you can't always pamper her, and she is just a little slow to react, and she is not really stupid." Penglai rubbed his slightly aching lips and made up his mind, "Anyway, I will discuss this matter with the senior brother. I believe that the senior brother will agree with me."
Yue Qiong snorted coldly, "Anyway, if something goes wrong at that time, you will be the one to go out and clean up the consequences for Xiao Liu, isn't it you, my dear?"
"You still have the nerve to say that?" Penglai glared at her hard, "Since childhood, when have you ever stabbed someone in the building and dealt with the consequences?"
"Whatever you want." She said as she turned a corner and wanted to go outside. "Is it nothing to do with me? I'll go talk to Xiaoliu."
"Don't hide in a hurry, senior brother is still waiting to see you." How could Penglai let her run away? Before applying oil on her soles, he turned her around, raised his finger and gently touched her eyebrows.
Chapter 1(2)
Yue Qiong, who was unable to move at the moment, had a stiff face, "Second, Second Senior Brother..."
"Now that you know you have to call me Senior Brother? What have you been doing all the time?" Penglai bent down and carried her on his shoulders in a business-like manner, then strode towards the back mountain Buddhist hall.
"Wait a minute... We have something to talk about. There is no need to go to the Buddhist temple all the time..." Yue Qiong, who finally realized that this time was inevitable, was so frightened that not only his heart trembled again and again, but even his voice trembled a little.
"You are blatantly abducting men on the street in broad daylight, right? Are you stripping men naked and painting them naked? Are you asking Emperor Xiyuan to send someone to complain to me to harm Xiyuan Kingdom? You have humiliated me Huangjinmen again, right? You also caused me to be reprimanded by senior brother for not teaching my junior sister well, right?" Penglai raised a palm without mercy, and every time he asked a question, the palm of his hand landed heavily on her butt that deserved a spanking.
"Second Senior Brother, I swear I will never write pornographic books in the future!" Being beaten like this at such a young age made Yue Qiong's face turn as red as a monkey's butt.
"You swear it's like farting." He continued to move towards the back hill with a steady pace.
"I promise never to draw a naked man again!"
"Since you have stripped off a man's clothes, you will take off a woman's clothes next time. Do you think I will allow you to go out and meddle with other men and women again?" She didn't believe her Penglai at all, and decided to completely prevent any possibility.
"Then... let's discuss it. Don't punish me this time for accompanying senior brother in chanting and copying sutras, okay?" Seeing the mountain behind him getting closer and closer, Yue Qiong couldn't help but break out in a cold sweat.
"Does it mean you want to be beaten half to death by senior brother? Don't worry, senior brother and I are so friendly to you, junior sister, and I will definitely fulfill your trivial wish."
Recalling all the cruel, cruel and outrageous educational methods used by senior brother in the past, Yue Qiong was silent for only a moment and then hurriedly shouted.
"Second Senior Brother, I was wrong!"
"It's late."
Can this half-immortal be stuffed back into the sky?
He really regrets it...
Lu Xiang, who was tortured to death by Gu Xing every day, didn't think so every day.
According to the soul servant who he named an immortal master, the big-name soul servant he made a wish came from the heaven and was a half-immortal who had achieved Taoism. The reason why Gu Xing was a semi-immortal and not a god was because he was not dead before he reached the age of immortality. Therefore, Gu Xing died unwillingly, so he was made a wish to become a mortal soul servant.
Not only did Gu Xing not acknowledge the fact that he had become a mortal soul, but he was also dissatisfied. He even refused to serve Lu Xiang, who was the soul master.
As a half-immortal, he didn't even pay attention to the blood contract on the soul paper, let alone accept instructions from mortals. He also threatened that if they dared to be disrespectful to him, a half-immortal, or wanted to force him to do anything, he would kill the soul master, and after dying together with the soul master... pat his butt and reincarnate.
Anyway, he has already died once, and it will make no difference to him if he dies again.
Lu Xiang and Lu Lu were both dumbfounded.
Die together... together?
Seeing Gu Xing as the last piece of driftwood, they worked hard to make wishes for him, not just to go to hell with him hand in hand!
Unfortunately, immortals are stronger than humans, so who teaches that half-immortals are also immortals? As long as Gu Xing refused to nod his head, they, the mortals whom he regarded as nothing, would not be able to do anything against him.
Especially when they knew that this half-immortal was once the Queen of the Immortal Turtle when she was in heaven.
No wonder he always moves so slowly. It takes him two years to walk one mile, and he has such a bad temper!
Lu Xiang, who was speechless every day because of Gu Xing's natural turtle nature, was going more and more crazy these days.
He spoke to Gu Xing angrily, but he responded with a cold eyebrow.
In addition, he is slow, everything is slow, even if he moves slowly, he can even speak so slowly that the listener will almost die! I would often listen to his last sentence and hold back my temper to wait for his next sentence. Waiting and waiting would usually be an hour later. But if I wanted to hear him finish a large paragraph completely, even if I had to wait day and night, as long as Gu Xing was in a bad mood, he would never be able to finish...
Also, even if he fed Gu Xing delicious food and drinks, he wouldn’t buy it.
Every day, Gu Xing slowly picked up the petals of the orchid, and slowly put them into his mouth one by one, chewing and savoring the taste of the petals, without even looking at the delicacies that Lu Xiang specially prepared for him.
After getting along with him for a long time, Lu Xiang, who had gone through countless hardships, finally figured out some of the rules of this immortal master.
This fairy turtle from the sky only drinks the dew on the leaf tips in the morning, and only eats the petals of orchids, and there are strict restrictions on the types of orchids. If it is not this kind of orchid, he will not eat other orchids, and if the flowers are not fresh, he will not eat them. If the flowers are not beautiful enough and the fragrance is not strong enough, he will refuse to eat them. Even if the time is not right, he will not eat them!
As a last resort, Lu Xiang had no choice but to shovel out all kinds of rare and exotic orchids planted in the imperial garden, and instead plant all kinds of roadside weed orchids that were designated by the Immortal Master and could be seen everywhere in the Lu Kingdom and were not worth a penny, so that the picky immortal turtle would often show him a coffin-like face.
